_sources.APP-67: PNAP APP-67 Energy Efficiency of Buildings (Building (Energy Efficiency) Regulation, Cap. 123M), revised Sept 2025 (AD/NB1). Read from bd.gov.hk on 2026-11-05.
_sources.APP-156: PNAP APP-156 Design and Construction Requirements for Energy Efficiency of Residential Buildings, revised Sept 2025. Read from bd.gov.hk on 2026-11-05.
_sources.BEC: Building Energy Code 2024 Edition (Cap. 610 BEEO), values as listed in EMSD's BEC & EAC 2024 briefing (emsd.gov.hk, read 2026-11-05), not the Code text itself. Gazetted 22 Nov 2024, fully in force 23 Aug 2025.
_sources.OTTV_Code: Code of Practice for Overall Thermal Transfer Value in Buildings 1995 (BD). NOT read: the PDF could not be reached. Formula structure from general knowledge; constants below are placeholders.

current.ref: APP-67 para 3 & 12; APP-156 para 6(b) for residents' recreational facilities

ottv_limits.applies_to: external walls and roofs of commercial and hotel buildings (B(EE)R); residents' recreational facilities of residential developments (APP-156)

rttv_limits.vlt_note: prescribed windows under B(P)R 30 and 31 only
rttv_limits.applies_to: domestic buildings (BO s.2(1)); excludes hotels, guesthouses, residential care homes; excludes A&A not creating a new residential building
rttv_limits.gfa_prerequisite: compliance is a prerequisite for GFA concessions under APP-151 (green / amenity features, non-mandatory plant rooms)

submission_stages.rttv: plans state compliance with RTTV, OTTV, VLT, ER (APP-156 para 7)

submission_stages.ottv: OTTV Summary Sheet, Appendix A (B(A)R reg 10)
submission_stages.rttv: RTTV + OTTV Summary Sheets, Appendices A and B (para 8)

submission_stages.ottv: finalised OTTVs on GBP; OTTV Report with Forms OTTV1-OTTV4, record plans, test certs, final Appendix A (para 8)
submission_stages.rttv: Energy Efficiency Report: RTTV calcs and forms, OTTV forms if any, record plans, test certs, final sheets, NVTC compliance (para 9)

ottv_constants._warning: PLACEHOLDER values, not from the OTTV Code 1995. Replace with the Code's tables (TDeq by wall / roof density, ΔT, solar factors by orientation) before relying on any result. Rough calibration only: BD sample sheet NT2022007OTTV (U 2.82 / 5.18, SC 0.65, α 0.75, 445 kg/m², WWR 1:1.59) reports wall OTTV 61.9 W/m²; these placeholders give 73.6 W/m² assuming glass spread evenly over N/E/S/W (orientations not on the sheet).

bec_lpd_W_m2._ref: BEC 2024 Table 5.4 (as listed in EMSD briefing). Classroom and other space types: read the Code.

beeo_triggers.new_building: BSI (A/C, electrical, lift & escalator, lighting) of the 13 building types in Schedule 4 BEEO comply with BEC; Form EE1 stage declaration and EE2 / EE3 (check with EMSD forms)

major_retrofitting.note: or central BSI motor / mechanical drive works (BEC Table 10.1)

beeo_triggers.energy_audit: commercial buildings and commercial portion of composite buildings (Schedule 1), Energy Audit Code, at intervals of not more than 10 years (check for later amendment)
